baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun اليوم is narrowed by the passive adjective الموعود.
baseline_models.mechanism: An otherwise open span of time is made determinate by an appointment: commitment supplies the day with a coordinate and makes waiting directional.

activation_trace.role: The open span of time supplies the temporal field that the adjective can narrow.
The appointed time or place turns the temporal field into a fixed rendezvous.

changed_reading.after: A future horizon made determinate by an undertaking, toward which the present is already oriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The event-bearing range of اليوم meets the speech-backed range of الموعود.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase joins a severe or notable occurrence to prior promissory speech, so the day is the point at which words become an event rather than merely a date on which something happens.

activation_trace.role: The event-day or severe occasion supplies an occurrence weightier than ordinary duration.
The spoken promise opens expectation and makes prior speech the event's causal prehistory.

changed_reading.before: A day that has been announced.
changed_reading.after: The event-day on which an earlier utterance acquires public reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unqualified passive الموعود does not name the beneficiary or the promised content.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory keeps promise and threat live together. The same day can open hope for one relation and menace another without forcing the phrase itself to choose between them.

activation_trace.role: The spoken undertaking can concern good or harm and therefore keeps expectation open.
The threat branch loads the same expectation with directed harm.
The severe event-day gives both hope and menace a single occasion of realization.

changed_reading.before: A promise with one unspecified but uniform outcome.
changed_reading.after: One event horizon carrying opposed expectations for differently situated participants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal noun اليوم and the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping for الموعود converge on measured waiting.
baseline_models.mechanism: A split-root echo recasts the appointment as a prescribed counted term whose recurrence or scheduled return gives waiting a measurable rhythm. This is an activation from the mapping, not a replacement gloss for الموعود.

activation_trace.role: The temporal span provides what can be measured and awaited.
The prescribed counted term makes waiting finite and answerable to a measure.
Counted time and recurrence add the image of a scheduled return rather than an indefinite delay.

changed_reading.before: An appointment whose distance is unknown.
changed_reading.after: An awaited term imagined as already counted and structurally due to recur or return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sky oath supplies an overhead field divided into celestial stations and even open to calculation. The appointed day can therefore be read as a coordinate in an ordered cosmic schedule, not only a date known by speech.

activation_trace.role: The temporal span supplies the coordinate's time axis.
The appointment fixes a point on that axis.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the encompassing coordinate field.
Celestial stations segment that field into recognizable positions.
The calculation branch makes those positions usable as an imagined schedule.

structural_cues: The repeated oath form places 85:1 and 85:2 in one coordinated opening sequence.
A spatially ordered sky is immediately followed by a temporally appointed day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent coordinated oaths, sky, celestial stations, calculation, and appointment; I infer a space-to-time indexing relation. A live alternative is that the oath objects share grandeur but no calendrical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A date fixed only by an undertaking.
changed_reading.after: A cosmically indexed appointment, as though the ordered sky already carries its coordinates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The active-passive witness pair following الموعود turns fulfillment into disclosure. The day is not complete merely by occurring; it becomes an event constituted by presence, sight, and knowledgeable declaration.

activation_trace.role: The notable event-day supplies the occasion that can become manifest.
Prior speech supplies the claim whose realization can be witnessed.
Presence with direct seeing makes fulfillment public rather than private.
Knowledgeable declaration converts seeing into evidentiary testimony.

structural_cues: The passive participle موعود is immediately followed by the active-passive pair شاهد ومشهود.
The three opening oath units coordinate appointment, witness, and witnessed object without resolving their referents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies participial parallelism and witness branches; I infer that witnessing describes how the promise becomes real. The pair may instead name independent oath objects, so identity with the day remains open.

changed_reading.before: A promised event that could occur without an audience.
changed_reading.after: A public evidentiary event whose fulfillment includes being seen and attestable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sunken enclosure, sustained fuel, fixed watching, and self-present testimony form a controlled spectacle. The threatened event-day reverses that apparatus: those who made others visible in pain cannot remain detached spectators of their own action.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day provides the later occasion on which positions can reverse.
The directed threat supplies pressure against the perpetrators' apparent control.
The long sunken trench supplies a spatial enclosure and an above-below asymmetry.
Fuel as the material of burning makes the spectacle maintained rather than momentary.
Sitting for watch or ambush makes the agents fixed observers over the enclosure.
Presence with seeing turns their chosen spectatorship into testimony to their own deed.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from trench to fuel to seated observers to what they do, preserving one spatial scene across 85:4-7.
The repeated pronoun هم keeps the watchers and actors continuous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, fuel, watching, action, and witnessing; I supply the arrow by which the promised threat reassigns observer and exposed object. The live alternative is punishment without a specific reversal of spectatorship.

changed_reading.before: A later threat detached from the narrated violence.
changed_reading.after: The day that overturns a coercive spectacle and makes its spectators answerable as their own witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exclusive construction makes trust itself the alleged fault, while the all-encompassing witness supplies knowledgeable review. The promised day becomes an adjudicative correction in which a false charge is exposed and punitive disapproval returns to those who invented it.

activation_trace.role: The threat branch supplies a sanction whose proper recipient is at issue.
Finding fault supplies the attackers' accusatory stance.
Punishment after disapproval supplies the coercive consequence they attach to that charge.
Security and settled trust disclose that the alleged offense is a relation of confidence.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the authority to reopen and correct the accusation.

structural_cues: The ما ... إلا construction restricts the persecutors' grievance to belief itself.
The following scope phrase over every thing prevents the violence from remaining an unreviewed local account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive blame, trust, punitive disapproval, and knowledgeable witness; I infer a reversal of charge and sanction. The witnessing can remain general surveillance rather than a formal hearing, so the legal register is functional rather than institutional.

changed_reading.before: A threat aimed at unnamed wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: A hearing-like correction where trust ceases to be the charge and the coercive accusers inherit the sanction they misassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human furnace first functions as an assay and inflicted burning. The paired outcome clauses then return burning to unrepentant assayers while opening concealed gardens, continuous flow, and rescue to the assayed. The one day differentiates relations rather than delivering one uniform result.

activation_trace.role: The event-day supplies one occasion capable of distributing opposed outcomes.
The broad promise branch keeps beneficial fulfillment available.
The threat branch keeps harmful fulfillment simultaneously available.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the persecutors' attempted sorting mechanism.
Burning and blackening expose the material violence inside that attempted assay.
Flame supplies the returned consequence on the harmful side of fulfillment.
A garden concealed by growth supplies protected abundance on the beneficial side.
Continuous provision replaces the maintained fuel with a maintained gift.
Attainment and rescue name the successful emergence from the ordeal.

structural_cues: The repeated لهم clauses in 85:10 are immediately countered by لهم جنات in 85:11.
The clause ثم لم يتوبوا makes the harmful outcome conditional on persisted non-return rather than identity alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, burning, non-return, garden, flow, and rescue; I infer that the later distribution reverses the persecutors' sorting apparatus. A live alternative is simple juxtaposition of outcomes without material reversal.

changed_reading.before: Either a hopeful promise or a threatening day.
changed_reading.after: A single differential fulfillment that returns the furnace to persistent assayers and converts endurance into protected, continuous life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired beginning and return verbs give the appointment causal shape. Their dominant return branch and their shared non-dominant counted-recurrence bridge make the day a hinge where an originating act comes back into effect, not an arbitrary deadline.

activation_trace.role: The temporal span supplies the interval across which beginning can reach return.
The non-dominant counted recurrence branch makes the appointed interval feel structurally due.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the first half of the causal arc.
Return after departure supplies completion rather than mere lateness.
The context root's split mapping repeats the counted-time image already activated at the focus.

structural_cues: The two present-tense verbs share an emphatic subject and form a balanced begin-return pair.
The focus and context roots independently converge on the same non-dominant counted-time branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired beginning and return plus a repeated mapped recurrence branch; I infer that the promised day closes their arc. The verbs may instead state general capacity, and the shared split-root image remains associative rather than semantic identity.

changed_reading.before: A deadline imposed from outside the processes of the world.
changed_reading.after: The due hinge at which originating agency returns and completes what its beginning set in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering a fault so its bearer is protected from its effect, followed by love, introduces a relational route through the threat. The appointment remains capable of restoration; severity describes one live relation to it, not the event's exhaustive meaning.

activation_trace.role: The broad undertaking keeps a beneficial relation to fulfillment open.
The threat remains real, allowing repair to be a changed relation rather than denial of harm.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer from the effect supplies remission within the appointment.
Love and affection move fulfillment beyond acquittal toward restored relation.

structural_cues: Forgiveness and love follow the severe grasp and the begin-return pair without a change of subject.
The earlier non-return clause leaves return as the unstated alternative to harmful fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, persisted non-return, forgiveness, and love; I infer that changed relation before fulfillment changes how the day is encountered. The attributes may characterize the actor generally without specifying the day's internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A fixed doom once threat has entered the reading.
changed_reading.after: A severe appointment that still contains remission and restored relation as coexisting possibilities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Royal elevation, effective action, and will gather behind the promissory utterance. The phrase becomes less like prediction and more like a commitment whose speaker possesses the authority and capacity to execute it.

activation_trace.role: The spoken undertaking supplies the commitment that requires backing.
The elevated royal seat supplies sovereign authority behind the undertaking.
Bringing an act about supplies execution rather than verbal assurance alone.
Will and intention align execution with the promisor's chosen end.

structural_cues: The predicate chain from throne-holder to intensive doer preserves one agent across authority, action, and will.
The intensive form فعال closes the gap between saying and doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies royal authority, intensive action, will, and promise; I infer a guarantee mechanism from their shared agent. A live alternative is that the attributes certify the speaker generally while the day remains a simple predicted event.

changed_reading.before: A prediction that awaits external conditions.
changed_reading.after: A self-backed commitment whose promisor is also its sovereign executor.

context_deltas.mechanism: A report itself comes, renews an event in speech, and carries the pattern of mutually supporting forces. The promised future therefore arrives provisionally as narrated history: report becomes a rehearsal that lets a later event press on the present before it occurs.

activation_trace.role: The spoken promise supplies future reality first carried by words.
Coming and arrival make the report act like an event entering the hearer's present.
Speech renewed as report gives a prior event fresh temporal presence.
A calamity of time supplies the event-pattern carried by the report.
A mutually supporting host supplies the recurring concentration of worldly force.

structural_cues: The interrogative هل أتاك grammatically presents speech as something that arrives.
The singular report gathers plural forces into a repeatable narrated pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arriving report, renewed speech, temporal calamity, and collective force; I infer that remembered events pre-enact the promised horizon. The report can instead be only an independent example with no rehearsal function.

changed_reading.before: A future event absent until its date.
changed_reading.after: A future event that already arrives in advance through recurring, present-tense narration of prior force and reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relation behind or on the other side combines with complete enclosure. Mapped onto the temporal appointment, this bends a straight future line: what seems merely ahead and absent is also the hidden boundary already surrounding the present.

activation_trace.role: The open temporal span supplies the apparent forward distance.
The appointment supplies the future point whose spatial relation is reimagined.
Concealment behind appearance supplies the event's felt absence.
The side that can be behind, ahead, or beyond destabilizes a single linear direction.
Sensory enclosure turns a remote point into a present boundary on every side.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and retention makes the future horizon already held.

structural_cues: The prepositional relation من ورائهم is immediately predicated as surrounding them.
The context joins directional remoteness to total enclosure in one clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies behind-or-beyond, concealment, and enclosure; I transfer that spatial topology to the promised day's temporal horizon. A live alternative is a purely spatial or epistemic claim with no effect on the meaning of futurity.

changed_reading.before: A point lying only ahead of the present.
changed_reading.after: A concealed future boundary that is paradoxically already around those moving toward it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation gathers the utterance, a writing surface gives it material persistence, and guarding keeps it from loss. The promised day is absent as event but present as preserved language, so textual transmission becomes part of how the commitment endures until fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: The spoken undertaking supplies language that must persist across delay.
Gathering and collection hold dispersed utterance together as one transmitted whole.
Reading and recitation repeatedly reactivate the commitment in the present.
A broad surface used for writing supplies material inscription and durable placement.
Guarding and watching preserve the inscription across the interval before fulfillment.
Fixity in memory gives the promise an inward mode of survival alongside inscription.

structural_cues: The corrective بل هو introduces the recited whole before locating it في لوح.
The final passive adjective محفوظ echoes the focus's passive موعود while changing futurity into preservation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, gathering, recitation, writing surface, and preservation; I infer that the text carries the appointment through time. The ending may guarantee the discourse as a whole without singling out the promised day.

changed_reading.before: A future whose only present form is expectation.
changed_reading.after: A future event already present, repeatable, and durable as guarded language.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م mapping under the sky root and the non-dominant ع د د mapping under الموعود. It remains anchored in the focus's day and appointment and is reinforced by the adjacent celestial stations. Render it as an associative calendar image, not as a lexical translation of either focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: اليوم supplies time, while الموعود supplies the counted recurrence to which an external mark can point.

activation_trace.role: The temporal span supplies what can become a season.
Counted recurrence supplies a due interval capable of returning.
A visible mark supplies public recognizability to the due interval.
A marked season where people gather turns recurrence into a social appointment.
Celestial stations give the seasonal mark a visible sky-borne frame.

changed_reading.after: A recurring public season imagined as visibly marked across the celestial field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it follows the third-rank ع و م mapping for الموعود into swimming and the annual cycle. It remains focus-anchored through the explicit temporal noun and a packet-supplied focus branch, but it should be presented only as kinetic imagery: time glides toward fulfillment rather than the adjective literally meaning motion or year.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase's temporal head can host the non-dominant motion and annual-cycle echoes attached to its adjective.

activation_trace.role: The open duration supplies the medium through which the appointment moves.
Swimming or gliding motion converts passive waiting into temporal movement.
The year-cycle bends that movement into recurrence rather than a one-way line.

changed_reading.before: A stationary date waiting in the distance.
changed_reading.after: A horizon toward which time itself seems to glide in cycles, carrying the present into fulfillment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ع د د counterpart branch beneath الموعود to connect deed and result. It remains anchored in the severe event-day and is activated by the context's produced action and opposed outcomes. Render it as a proportional or matching mechanism, not as proof of a technical accounting sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The event-day is reimagined through the adjective's split mapping as the counterpart against which actions are matched.

activation_trace.role: The severe occasion supplies the meeting point for action and consequence.
A counterpart counted with another supplies the matching relation.
A produced action supplies one side of the match.
Punishment following disapproval supplies a consequence that can be reassigned to its fitting act.
Attainment and rescue supply the opposed fitting result for endurance.

changed_reading.before: A day on which consequences happen.
changed_reading.after: A counterpart-day that brings each enacted relation face to face with a fitting result.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-material activation: the packet's tablet root includes both heat changing a surface and a board used for writing, while preservation guards what remains. It stays anchored in the focus as the promised severe event whose truth must endure after violence. Downstream prose should mark it as an image of indelible memory, not claim that the final tablet literally records a burn scar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The severe event-day and spoken undertaking require the ordeal to remain legible until fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day supplies the later disclosure of what violence meant.
The spoken undertaking requires a memory bridge between injury and fulfillment.
Fire and flame supply the material force capable of leaving a mark.
Heat's effect in changing color supplies the image of an embodied trace.
A writing board converts the trace into legible record.
Guarding preserves the record against erasure before the promised disclosure.

changed_reading.before: A later event that remembers earlier violence only propositionally.
changed_reading.after: A promised disclosure imagined as preserving the ordeal's heat-mark until it can be read and answered.

strongest_changes: The context turns a bare appointment into a public evidentiary event that reverses the trench spectators' position.
The furnace, garden, flow, forgiveness, and love preserve harmful, beneficial, and reparative fulfillments as coexisting relations to one day.
Beginning-return, present enclosure, and guarded recitation make the future causally due, already surrounding, and verbally present before it occurs.
summary.what_was_special: The split mappings did not merely add synonyms: they activated counted recurrence, seasonal marking, gliding annual motion, and counterpart matching, while dominant branches tied those odd images back to appointment, witness, reversal, sovereign execution, and preserved speech.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether شاهد ومشهود directly characterize the promised day or remain neighboring oath objects with independent referents.
Whether celestial stations genuinely index time here or only enlarge the scale of the oath sequence.
Whether وراء and محيط can reshape linear futurity into present enclosure rather than remain spatial or epistemic predicates.
How much interpretive weight the non-dominant mapped roots can bear beyond associative activation.
